positiveEvidence: Vietri sul Mare public/tourism documentation identifies NRG4YOU at Corso Umberto I / Piazza Matteotti and directs users to https://customer.restation.eu/stations.

The documented station card exposes PRENOTA and RICARICA actions and describes 2 Type 2 22 kW sockets with 'Accesso a Pagamento', proving a paid direct-use flow exists even though the exact price is not exposed in the indexed public evidence.
Open Charge Map currently associates NRG4YOU in Italy with https://customer.restation.eu/stations, corroborating ReStation as the customer-facing surface.

Centro Per le Comunita Solari independently uses the same customer.restation.eu platform for its Community Charger web charging flow, proving ReStation is a shared platform and therefore a ReStation tariff observed for another network must never be transposed to NRG4YOU.
